summary: All coder and tester changes integrate cleanly. Orchestrator tests added to CI and Bandit scan, pytest config consolidated into pyproject.toml, documentation updated. Full test suite passes with 4956 tests across tests/, gateway/tests/, and orchestrator/tests/.

core_unit_tests.details: Full core unit test suite (tests/) passes. 3426 passed, 80 skipped, 3 warnings.

gateway_tests.details: All gateway tests (gateway/tests/) pass. 1080 passed, 3 skipped, 1 warning.

orchestrator_tests.details: 450 orchestrator tests pass. 2 collection errors (test_container_spawner.py, test_docker_client.py) due to missing docker Python library in sandbox — pre-existing, not caused by this PR. These files import docker at module level. In CI with uv sync --extra dev, docker>=7.0.0 will be installed and these will collect.

ci_config_validation_tests.details: All 11 new CI config validation tests pass: pytest.ini removed, pyproject.toml has correct testpaths/markers/config, test.yml includes orchestrator in unit tests and PYTHONPATH, bandit scan includes orchestrator, CONTRIBUTING.md lists orchestrator tests, Makefile bandit help includes orchestrator, mypy overrides include orchestrator.tests.*.

combined_run.details: Combined run of tests/ + gateway/tests/ + orchestrator/tests/ (excluding docker-dependent collection errors). 4956 passed, 83 skipped, 4 warnings.

marker_filtered_run.details: Run with standard CI marker exclusions (not integration, functional, e2e, security, agent_flaky). 4882 passed, 8 skipped, 149 deselected.

ruff.details: All ruff checks passed. 4 pre-existing noqa warnings for custom rule EGG100 (not an issue).

test_yml_orchestrator_inclusion.details: test.yml unit job includes orchestrator/tests/ in pytest command and 'orchestrator' in PYTHONPATH.

bandit_scan_orchestrator_inclusion.details: test.yml security job includes 'orchestrator' in bandit -r targets.

pyproject_toml_consolidation.details: pytest.ini removed. pyproject.toml has correct testpaths (tests, gateway/tests, orchestrator/tests), all required markers (integration, functional, e2e, security, agent_flaky), and proper addopts.

pyproject_dev_dependencies.details: docker>=7.0.0 added to dev dependencies for orchestrator tests that import docker.

mypy_overrides.details: orchestrator.tests.* mypy override added with disallow_untyped_defs=false and ignore_missing_imports=true, matching gateway.tests.* pattern.

documentation_consistency.details: CONTRIBUTING.md lists orchestrator tests. Makefile bandit help includes orchestrator.

test_isolation.details: test_cli.py patches cli.logger to prevent logging interaction. test_devserver.py uses MagicMock for docker_client when None.

on_check_failure_compatibility.details: on-check-failure.yml listens for 'Test' workflow completions. The test.yml workflow name is 'Test'. No changes to workflow triggers, so autofix compatibility is maintained.

observations.description: The analysis draft (632-analysis.md) identified 'Issue 1: Lint and Test Workflows Never Run on PRs' as critical and recommended adding pull_request triggers to lint.yml and test.yml. The implementation addressed Issues 2 (orchestrator tests not in CI) and 3 (duplicate pytest config) but did not add pull_request triggers. This means lint and test workflows still only run via workflow_call/workflow_dispatch — not automatically on PRs. This is the most impactful gap identified in the analysis but is outside the scope of the current implementation commits.

pre_existing_issues.description: orchestrator/tests/test_container_spawner.py and test_docker_client.py fail to collect due to missing docker Python library in sandbox environment. These will work in CI where uv sync --extra dev installs docker>=7.0.0.

4 ruff warnings for custom rule EGG100 in noqa comments (sandbox/llm/claude/runner.py, integration_tests/test_network_isolation.py, tests/functional/conftest.py, sandbox/egg_lib/docker.py). Pre-existing, not related to this PR.

commits_on_branch.message: Fix test isolation and add CI config validation tests
Update docs to include orchestrator in test and security scan listings
Consolidate pytest config into pyproject.toml, delete pytest.ini
Add orchestrator tests to CI and Bandit security scan
Add docker to dev extras and fix test_cli.py logging interaction
Add analysis draft for issue #632: audit tests
